subject.title: fix(plugins): report missing config clearly instead of misleading required-property errors

question: Should the repeated startup validation path be corrected by carrying resolved plugin config into that path, or by lifecycle-owned deduplication when unresolved config is temporarily expected?
rationale: Both approaches can reduce spam, but selecting the authoritative lifecycle boundary affects plugin loading and config validation ownership beyond a mechanical diagnostic rewrite.

options.title: Carry resolved config forward
options.body: Trace the post-ready validation caller and pass its already-resolved plugin entry into validation, using deduplication only for genuinely transient states.

options.title: Deduplicate transient errors
options.body: Keep the unresolved validation call but suppress identical plugin-config diagnostics within a lifecycle-owned bounded window.

options.title: Limit this PR to diagnostics
options.body: Land only the wording improvement without closing the linked issue, leaving the repeated lifecycle behavior for separate work.

recommendation.title: Carry resolved config forward
recommendation.body: Trace the post-ready validation caller and pass its already-resolved plugin entry into validation, using deduplication only for genuinely transient states.

likelyOwner.reason: They already identified the relevant lifecycle boundary and specified the acceptable redesign constraints.
